newsitem.title: USA: SFX Broadcasting files shelf registration.
newsitem.headline: SFX Broadcasting files shelf registration.

text.p: SFX Broadcasting Inc said Wednesday it filed a shelf registration for up to $500 million of its securities.

"The purpose of filing this shelf registration is to give us complete flexibility for any additional financing necessary to fund our previously announced acquisition of Secret Communications, which is expected to close in the second half of 1997," the company said.

SFX also filed a registration statement covering about 300,000 shares for the benefit of certain SFX shareholders who had granted irrevocable proxies in connection with the company's recently completed merger with Multi-Market Radio Inc.
With the anticipated consummation of all previously announced transactions, SFX will own and operate or provide services to the following 78 radio stations in 23 markets.
